AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
This app exposes the DevFest Ourense agenda and the user's favourite talks.
Operational Patterns: - Use 'searchTalks' to resolve talks to IDs before calling 'addToFavorites'. - Prefer one 'addToFavorites' call with several IDs over repeated calls.
Constraints: - 'clearFavorites' is irreversible: confirm with the user before calling it. - Times are local to the event.
